title: Analytic Spread Complexity from Level Statistics: From Chaos to Integrability
summary: Spread complexity has emerged as a useful probe of quantum chaos, yet the microscopic spectral origin of its characteristic finite-time peak remains incompletely understood. We develop an analytic framework that relates spread complexity directly to local spectral statistics. Starting from an energy-space representation of the Krylov kernel, we show that the kernel is approximately banded, leading to a rapidly convergent diagonal expansion dominated by nearby levels in the ordered spectrum.
